AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Pest and Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Pest and Disease Control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Pest and Disease Control.

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen and Backyard Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Animal Products 9 2.6 Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygie.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen.

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Water Harvesting and Storage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kitchen and Backyard Gardening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Poultry Rearing in a Fold and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Pest and Disease Control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
